sources.label: Paper main results and experimental setup
Original SFT launcher
sources.locator: 8 workers; global batch 1024; micro batch 16; seed 42

paper.backbone_size_note: Section 4 specifies the backbone family; Table 1 does not identify a unique parameter count. Do not assume it is matched to this run's 1.5B Base model.
limitations: No Video Games results are reported in the original Table 1 or repository result image. Cross-domain values are context, not a matched reproduction target.
Only K=3,5,10 are published in Table 1. No values at K=1,20,50 are inferred or interpolated.
This run is Qwen2.5-1.5B Base SFT only; the original main result uses the paper's complete post-training recipe.
Use Table 1 consistently: the Industrial row in Table 3 has different values and is a separate experiment.
The paper and current launcher differ in some setup details; the current run_config.json is authoritative for this experiment.
Differences in domain, catalog size, sequence length, SID selection, alignment tasks and training stage prevent attribution of a score gap to a single cause.
Paper loss curves are not a matched numeric target across tokenizers, task mixtures and label masking. Before/after loss in this run must use the same token-weighted answer-only evaluation protocol.

comparability.note: selected quantizer epoch vs paper quantizer training budget

comparison.limitation: 原论文没有 Video Games 结果；不同数据域、Base/Instruct、SFT/RL 阶段及 SID 等设置只可作背景参照，不能据此计算复现提升或判定复现成功。

prediction_diagnostics.cold_definition: All catalog items absent from every training behavior history and target.

interpretation: Behavior-cold means absent from every training history and target, not an unknown catalog item or unknown metadata.
Metadata/SID alignment uses the shared full catalog; duplicate titles reduce reverse title-to-SID task coverage.
Every original test row has equal weight, including repeated interactions; item counts and row counts use different denominators.
Repeat-last target frequency measures label distribution. Actual top-1 copying and its correct/wrong counts measure model behavior separately.
These strata describe association and distribution shift; they do not identify a causal explanation or demonstrate a paper replication.
Rolling histories may include earlier validation/test interactions. Equal timestamps can cross adjacent global chronological split boundaries.
behavior_shift_analysis.scope: post-hoc exploratory strata on the original full-catalog predictions; no candidate filtering
behavior_shift_analysis.prediction_integrity_scope: Diagnostic utility verified prediction bytes; renderer binds its stored hash and exact evaluation-metrics identity without rehashing prediction data

protocol.split: full original test split; no row deduplication
protocol.checkpoint_selection: validation loss only; test unused for selection
protocol.validity_interpretation: catalog-constrained decoding validity is a structural check, not recommendation accuracy
protocol.perplexity_interpretation: masked answer-token perplexity; not general-language perplexity

expectation_analysis.interpretation: Assess signal quality on this dataset; this is not paper reproduction or a statistical significance test.
expectation_analysis.conclusion_scope: Optimization and numerical integrity only; behavior-cold recommendation quality is assessed separately using post-hoc strata
